name: Chris
text: I stay in lots of Airbnb’s, this was the best I’ve ever stayed in with regard to thoughtfulness of the host. Seriously a wonderful stay, thank you so much!

name: Charles
text: Me and my family love this place. We have stayed at two of their homes. I recommend!!! The staff is also very nice! Ain’t nothing worse than walking pass mad people every day lol but you will not have to worry about that they are awesome

name: Randy
text: Awesome space! I will definitely book this stay again when I'm back in town. They were very prompt when I locked myself out. Thank you for sharing your space with me!

name: Felix
text: It’s been it's been a pleasure to stay with you. Clean room, good view, great facilities and very good check in and out. Great communication and clear instructions. All in all a great stay that I would recommend.

name: Richard
text: It’s actually cozy and the neighborhood is safe. 1 block from 7-11 and Tops. Down street from the mall and gym. Bed was hella comfortable and pillows were also…good price for the value.

name: Rani
text: We stayed here with a multi-generational group (young children & older grandparents included). The space and layout was perfect for us all. The atmosphere was very peaceful and laid back & the pool makes it a good spot for young families. The host was very responsive to any questions we had.

name: Stephan
text: Stayed five nights at this property over Christmas. The only problem was that I had to leave. Cannot recommend this place highly enough for someone that wants some peace and quiet, local flair and easy to reach everywhere within 10 minutes drive. A privilege to stay at such a beautiful old Thai house. Thank you to the host, always communicating and pro-active, I will be back for sure.
